description: This file contains helper functions for interacting with the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including request handling, URL creation, data retrieval, and specific functions for financial data like historical prices and earnings transcripts.

methods.name: response_callback(response, _)
methods.description: Handles the HTTP response, raising errors for unauthorized or error messages, and returns parsed JSON data.

methods.name: Union[list,dict] get_data(url: str, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Fetches data from a specified FMP API URL asynchronously.

methods.name: Union[list,dict] get_data_urls(urls: list[str], **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Fetches data from multiple FMP API URLs asynchronously.

methods.name: str create_url( version: int, endpoint: str, api_key: Optional[str], query: Optional[Any] = None, exclude: Optional[list[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the FMP API using version, endpoint, API key, and query parameters.

methods.name: list[dict] get_data_many( url: str, sub_dict: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Fetches data from a URL and processes it into a list of dictionaries, handling sub-dictionaries.

methods.name: dict get_data_one(url: str, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Fetches data from a URL and ensures the result is a dictionary.

methods.name: date most_recent_quarter(base: Optional[date] = None)
methods.description: Returns the date of the most recent fiscal quarter based on a given or current date.

methods.name: str get_interval(value: str)
methods.description: Converts a duration string into a format suitable for the FMP API.

methods.name: list[dict] get_historical_ohlc(query, credentials, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Retrieves historical OHLC data from the FMP API, with support for price adjustments and intervals.

methods.name: list get_available_transcript_symbols(api_key)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of symbols for which earnings call transcripts are available, cached for efficiency.

methods.name: list get_transcript_dates_for_symbol(symbol: str, api_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves available earnings call transcript dates for a given symbol, cached for efficiency.

ctags.name: create_url
ctags.signature: ( version: int, endpoint: str, api_key: Optional[str], query: Optional[Any] = None, exclude: Optional[list[str]] = None, )

ctags.name: get_data
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_data(url: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[list, dict]:$/

ctags.name: get_data_many
ctags.signature: ( url: str, sub_dict: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any )

ctags.name: get_data_urls
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_data_urls(urls: list[str], **kwargs: Any) -> Union[list, dict]:$/
